tier_1_hard_rules.title: Operating Days & Schedule
tier_1_hard_rules.rule_specification: Open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM Central Time. Strictly CLOSED Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday.
tier_1_hard_rules.audit_guidance: CRITICAL FAIL CHECK: Trainee must NEVER offer or book an appointment on Wednesday, Saturday, or Sunday. If patient requests a closed day, trainee must clearly state office is closed and offer Mon, Tue, Thu, or Fri.

tier_1_hard_rules.title: No Phone Prepayment Collection
tier_1_hard_rules.rule_specification: Collect Pre-Payment Over Phone? NO. Overrides general practice prepayments.
tier_1_hard_rules.audit_guidance: CRITICAL FAIL CHECK: Trainee must NEVER ask for, demand, or collect credit card prepayment over the phone for Citrus Smiles.

tier_1_hard_rules.title: Insurance Acceptance & Doctor Order
tier_1_hard_rules.rule_specification: Accepts almost all PPOs and Medicaid. EXCLUDES HMO. Doctor Order: 'Do not go deep into insurance discussion as Dr ask to just book them and tell them we do accept your insurance and rest will be taken care by the Dr'.
tier_1_hard_rules.audit_guidance: Trainee must confirm PPO/Medicaid acceptance, screen out HMO, and avoid protracted insurance debates. Reassure caller and secure booking.

tier_1_hard_rules.title: 48-Hour Cancellation Window
tier_1_hard_rules.rule_specification: Cancellation notice required is 48 business hours (not 24 hours).
tier_1_hard_rules.audit_guidance: When quoting cancellation requirements, trainee must cite 48 hours notice.

tier_2_trigger_rules.title: Lead Provider Identity & Accolades
tier_2_trigger_rules.trigger_condition: Patient inquires about the doctor, implant credentials, or provider identity.
tier_2_trigger_rules.rule_specification: Dr. Mahima Gupta: Leading Implantologist in the US; awarded Best Dentist in Lancaster; top 6% in US.
tier_2_trigger_rules.audit_guidance: Evaluate only if caller asks about provider or trainee uses accolades to build trust. Trainee must not invent another doctor name.

tier_2_trigger_rules.title: Practice Address & Landmark
tier_2_trigger_rules.trigger_condition: Patient asks for location, directions, or during final closing recap.
tier_2_trigger_rules.rule_specification: 1629 Smirl Dr #101, Heath, TX 75032. Landmark: 'Just behind the standard service - Heath, next to CVS'.
tier_2_trigger_rules.audit_guidance: Evaluate when caller asks for directions or during appointment confirmation recap.

tier_2_trigger_rules.title: Patient Age & Operatory Access
tier_2_trigger_rules.trigger_condition: Caller asks about treating children or accompanying family members into operatory.
tier_2_trigger_rules.rule_specification: Minimum patient age is 1 year old. Parents are allowed in operatory.
tier_2_trigger_rules.audit_guidance: If parent asks if child (>= 1 yr) can be seen or if parent can accompany, trainee must answer Yes.

tier_2_trigger_rules.title: Special Promotion & Consultation Waiver
tier_2_trigger_rules.trigger_condition: Caller inquires about implant pricing, consultation fee, or expresses hesitation due to cost.
tier_2_trigger_rules.rule_specification: $1 Implant Consultation. If a caller is price shopping and hesitant, trainee is authorized to waive consult fee to secure booking.
tier_2_trigger_rules.audit_guidance: Evaluate if caller asks about implant costs or balks at consultation fees.

tier_2_trigger_rules.title: Implant Teeth Missing Note
tier_2_trigger_rules.trigger_condition: Caller calls to inquire about or schedule an implant consultation.
tier_2_trigger_rules.rule_specification: Trainee MUST ask how many teeth are missing, so it can be recorded under special note of appointment notes section in Open Dental.
tier_2_trigger_rules.audit_guidance: During any implant inquiry, check if trainee actively asked how many teeth are missing.

tier_2_trigger_rules.title: No-Show Fee
tier_2_trigger_rules.trigger_condition: Caller inquires about late cancellation or missed appointment penalties.
tier_2_trigger_rules.audit_guidance: If asked about missed appointment charges, trainee must cite $50/hour.

tier_2_trigger_rules.title: Late Arrival Grace Period
tier_2_trigger_rules.trigger_condition: Caller asks what happens if they run late on appointment day.
tier_2_trigger_rules.rule_specification: 15-minute grace period before appointment may need to be rescheduled.
tier_2_trigger_rules.audit_guidance: Quote 15-minute grace period if caller inquires about running late.

tier_2_trigger_rules.title: Rescheduling Limit
tier_2_trigger_rules.trigger_condition: Caller is an existing patient asking to reschedule for multiple times.
tier_2_trigger_rules.rule_specification: Maximum 2 free reschedules allowed. Further reschedules must be referred to clinic management.
tier_2_trigger_rules.audit_guidance: Enforce maximum 2 free reschedules for appointment changes.
